rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for interrupting someone's peace, concentration, or activity.

example.english: Don't disturb me while I'm doing my homework.
example.jyutping: m4 hou2 daa2 jiu2 ngo5 zou6 gung1 fo3

rows.note: Use this when the disturbance is specifically causing emotional distress, worry, or confusion.

example.english: This problem continues to disturb me.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 jat1 zik6 kwan3 jiu2 ngo5
